system.boundary: Build a complete burst-mode IEEE 802.11n high-throughput baseband link in Simulink.
engineering_objects: The receiver must autonomously detect each packet, acquire timing and carrier synchronization, estimate the 2-by-2 channel from the received HT training fields, separate and equalize both spatial streams, track the data-field pilots, estimate noise power, demodulate and decode the PSDU, and report packet recovery quality.
physical_paths: Build a complete burst-mode IEEE 802.11n high-throughput baseband link in Simulink.
Pass every packet through a causal stochastic 2-by-2 TGn multipath-fading channel and additive noise before it reaches the receiver.
mcs_index is a valid two-spatial-stream HT MCS from 8 through 15, and spatial_mapping is Direct or Fourier.

The receiver must autonomously detect each packet, acquire timing and carrier synchronization, estimate the 2-by-2 channel from the received HT training fields, separate and equalize both spatial streams, track the data-field pilots, estimate noise power, demodulate and decode the PSDU, and report packet recovery quality.
functional_paths: The receiver must autonomously detect each packet, acquire timing and carrier synchronization, estimate the 2-by-2 channel from the received HT training fields, separate and equalize both spatial streams, track the data-field pilots, estimate noise power, demodulate and decode the PSDU, and report packet recovery quality.

interfaces.name: packet_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named packet_state, synchronization_state, mimo_state, and quality_state. packet_state has width 16385: channels 1-8192 are the transmitted 1024-byte PSDU bits in bit order, channels 8193-16384 are the corresponding recovered PSDU bits, and channel 16385 is the packet-detected flag; all are unitless binary values.

interfaces.name: synchronization_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named packet_state, synchronization_state, mimo_state, and quality_state. synchronization_state has width 4 in this order: coarse packet offset (samples), coarse CFO estimate (Hz), fine CFO estimate (Hz), and symbol-timing offset (samples).

interfaces.name: mimo_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named packet_state, synchronization_state, mimo_state, and quality_state. mimo_state has width 7 in this order: the flattened 2-by-2 complex channel estimate H11, H21, H12, H22 in MATLAB column-major order; the equalized complex symbols for spatial streams 1 and 2; and estimated noise power.

interfaces.name: quality_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named packet_state, synchronization_state, mimo_state, and quality_state. quality_state has width 3 in this order: packet-error rate, packet-error count, and compared-packet count. The channel estimate and equalized symbols must be the actual receiver-internal quantities used to recover the same PSDUs counted by quality_state.
